name: GitHub Event Router
description: Claims every message in the GitHub feed channel except the owner's. GitHub app posts become queue files for issue-worker-bots, pr-review-bots and the verified-command drain; no GitHub post reaches an agent turn directly.

channelId.description: Slack channel id of the GitHub feed (default C0CEMPH1L0N).

queueRoot.description: Absolute directory that holds the iwb/, prbot/ and ops/ queues (default ~/.local/state/github-events).

ownerSenderIds.description: Slack user ids whose messages get the normal agent turn, each optionally prefixed with slack:, user: or slack:user: (any case). Each id at most once. When set, even to an empty list, it replaces channels.slack.allowFrom.

botSenderIds.description: Slack sender ids of the GitHub app. Only these are queued. Empty (the default) queues nothing; other bot posts are claimed without queueing and logged as 'unknown bot sender <id>'.
